_readme: Parameters the SQL kit, the assumption governance step and the Databricks notebook share, so each value lives in one place. 01_run_sql_kit.py renders them into the SQL (with the paid-through month from run_config.json) and stops if any placeholder is left unfilled. Pooling points cap large claims in the experience; the expected excess over them is reported as a pooling charge in output/assumptions/assumption_indications.csv. The A/E expected basis is deliberately simple for the synthetic book; in production it is replaced by the approved assumption basis for the monitoring period (owner: forecasting actuary).
